outcome: Use of vasoactive medications (dobutamine, norepinephrine, vasopressin, milrinone, inhaled nitric oxide, levosimendan, beta blockers)
cohort: 70 neonates born following a complicated monochorionic twin pregnancy admitted to the department of neonatology of the University Children's Hospital Bonn between October 2019 and December 2023.
finding: Early pulmonary hypertension and cardiac dysfunction are frequent diagnoses in neonates following a complicated monochorionic twin pregnancy, requiring an individualized vasoactive treatment strategy.
